items.title: Moat — Command Code's $5/month model router with no router fee
items.summary: A flat-fee model router that sells 105 models at member prices with no router fee.

items.title: go/codegolf benchmark — GPT-6.2 Astra is first to beat Google's human records
items.summary: A code-golf benchmark built from Google's 2015 internal contest, where GPT-6.2 Astra now beats the human records.

items.title: ChatGPT combined Chat and Work — OpenAI starts testing one tab with Pro users
items.summary: ChatGPT's separate Work tab is folding into regular Chat, starting with a small Pro test group.

items.title: llm.asm — Qwen3-0.6B runs on a 24 KB bare-metal OS in pure assembly
items.summary: A Qwen model that boots like an operating system, written entirely in assembly.

items.title: Polynomial Hirsch conjecture disproved — OpenAI's AI-written polytope proof
items.summary: An internal OpenAI model's preprint says a polytope's corners can be far more than polynomially far apart.

items.title: GPT-6.2 usage billing fix — Astra limits hit 40% sooner, Sol 25%
items.summary: OpenAI fixed a GPT-6.2 billing bug, so ChatGPT and Codex plans now run out of Astra and Sol usage sooner.

items.title: Claude computer use — now in beta for Team and Enterprise
items.summary: Claude can now see the screen and use allowed desktop apps for Team and Enterprise organizations.

items.title: New ChatGPT mobile app design — Home and Explore tabs
items.summary: ChatGPT's phone app gets two bottom tabs and pinnable tools.

items.title: ChatGPT Health — now on Android, desktop, dots and sites
items.summary: ChatGPT Health leaves iPhone and web: Android and desktop get it too.

items.title: Responses API healthcare configurations — a clinical harness for OpenAI models
items.summary: Select OpenAI models now come with a clinical-question harness in the API.

items.title: ChatGPT Space — now rolling out to Plus users
items.summary: Space moves from the launch plans down to ChatGPT Plus.

items.title: Claude Mobile — a refreshed look, starting on iOS
items.summary: Claude's iPhone app gets a new look with no settings to change.

items.title: Claude file transfers — send files to connected apps and save files from them
items.summary: Claude can now move files in and out of your connected apps, such as cloud storage.

items.title: Claude monthly recap — Reflect leaves beta and adds Claude Code and Cowork
items.summary: Claude's usage recap is out of beta and now covers coding and Cowork work too.

items.title: The New York Times tells photographers to avoid Photoshop 2027 over AI
items.summary: A major newsroom tells photographers to stay on the older Photoshop because new AI features are too easy to trigger by accident.

items.title: GRH in Lean — Anthropic staff and Claude shrink the RH proof to 76k lines
items.summary: A far shorter, machine-checked Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis that also covers the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.

items.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys — five-year ban starts 90 days after signing
items.summary: New York becomes the second US state, after California, to ban toys with built-in AI chatbots.

items.title: Scott Aaronson — 'Holy shit': AI math results point toward P ≠ NP
items.summary: A complexity theorist says AI may be starting a 'singularity' limited to hard math problems.

items.title: Ling-3.2-air — Ant Group's open 124B multimodal MoE for workflow automation
items.summary: An open multimodal model that keeps only 5.5B of its 124B parameters active, tuned for automation and document work.

items.title: Anthropic moves its Messages API to Rust — 70% less CPU per request
items.summary: Anthropic explains how Claude agents ported its main API to Rust, with live traffic as the test.

items.title: Mass Spec Skills — Antigravity agent identifies molecules from MS/MS spectra
items.summary: A Google Antigravity plugin that helps chemists work out which molecule produced a mass spectrum.

items.title: Fireship — '17 million lines of AI slop just cracked a 167-year-old math problem...'
items.summary: Fireship explains the Claude-written Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis in a short video.

items.title: Cogentic papers — Google's AI agent claims faster proven integer factoring
items.summary: A Google agent posted six theory papers in one day, including a claimed proven speed-up for integer factoring.

items.title: OCRia-nano-1 — LlamaIndex's 8.1M-parameter OCR model for plain CPUs
items.summary: A tiny OCR and layout model that reads tables and documents on an ordinary CPU, no GPU needed.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Claude AI's Biggest Math Breakthrough Has A Problem.'
items.summary: Two Minute Papers revisits the Claude-assisted Riemann Hypothesis proof and asks what is still missing.
